[
{"id":"ka0050","verbatim":"Our ability to generate revenues depends on the demand for our services in these sectors.","paraphrase":"Our capacity to earn income hinges on how much demand exists for our services in these industries.","different_hard":"Our ability to generate revenue does not depend on the demand for our services in these industries."},
{"id":"ka0051","verbatim":"Such warrants provide that if the closing price of our common stock is equal to or above $12.50 per share for 20 consecutive trading days, upon 15 trading days' prior written notice, we will have the right to, and the warrant holders will have the right to require us to, call and cancel any unexercised portion of the warrants (subject to certain conditions).","paraphrase":"Under the terms of these warrants, we may call and cancel any portion not yet exercised, and the holders may require us to do so, once our common stock has closed at or above $14.00 per share on 30 consecutive trading days and we have given 10 trading days' advance written notice, subject to certain conditions.","different_hard":"Such warrants provide that if the closing price of our common stock is equal to or below $14.00 per share for 30 consecutive trading days, upon 10 trading days' prior written notice, we will have the right to, but the warrant holders will not have the right to require us to, call and cancel any unexercised portion of the warrants (subject to certain conditions)."},
{"id":"ka0052","verbatim":"Our use of “open source” software could negatively affect our ability to sell our products and subject us to possible litigation.","paraphrase":"Incorporating “open source” software into our offerings may hinder our ability to market our products and expose us to potential lawsuits.","different_hard":"Our use of “open source” software could improve our ability to sell our products and reduce our exposure to possible litigation."},
{"id":"ka0053","verbatim":"We file for patents covering both our technologies and product candidates, as we deem appropriate.","paraphrase":"Where we consider it suitable, we seek patent protection for our technologies and product candidates.","different_hard":"We apply for patents covering neither our technologies nor our product candidates, as we deem appropriate."},
{"id":"ka0054","verbatim":"Additionally, if our independent registered public accounting firm is unable to rely on our internal controls over financial reporting in connection with their audit of our financial statements, and in the further event that they are unable to devise alternative procedures in order to satisfy themselves as to the material accuracy of our financial statements and related disclosures, it is conceivable that we could receive a qualified or adverse audit opinion on those financial statements.","paraphrase":"If our independent auditors cannot depend on our internal controls over financial reporting when auditing our financial statements, and they also cannot design substitute procedures that let them conclude our financial statements and related disclosures are materially accurate, it is possible that we could receive a qualified or adverse audit opinion on those statements.","different_hard":"In addition, if our independent registered public accounting firm is unable to rely on our internal controls over financial reporting in connection with their audit of our financial statements, and in the further event that they are unable to devise alternative procedures in order to satisfy themselves as to the material accuracy of our financial statements and related disclosures, it is possible that we could receive an unqualified audit opinion on those financial statements."},
{"id":"ka0055","verbatim":"Customer retention is a critical factor for continued profitability.","paraphrase":"Keeping existing customers is an important determinant of whether we remain profitable over time.","different_hard":"Customer retention is a minor factor for continued profitability."},
{"id":"ka0056","verbatim":"If the parties fail to complete a transaction on which we are advising or an offering in which we are participating, we will earn minimal or no revenue from the transaction.","paraphrase":"Should the parties not finish a deal we are advising on, or an offering we are involved in, our revenue from that deal will be little or none.","different_hard":"If the parties complete a transaction on which we are advising or an offering in which we are participating, we will earn little or no revenue from the transaction."},
{"id":"ka0057","verbatim":"If we pay higher prices, our profitability may be diminished.","paraphrase":"Should the prices we pay rise, our profitability may decline.","different_hard":"If we pay lower prices, our profitability may be reduced."},
{"id":"ka0058","verbatim":"Moreover, these purchases may make it less likely that the holders of 20% or more of the IPO shares vote against a business combination and exercise their conversion rights.","paraphrase":"These purchases may also reduce the chance that holders owning at least 30% of the IPO shares will vote against a business combination and elect to convert their shares.","different_hard":"Furthermore, these purchases may make it more likely that the holders of 30% or more of the IPO shares vote against a business combination and exercise their conversion rights."},
{"id":"ka0059","verbatim":"These risks may reduce the funds available for distribution to the Company’s shareholders.","paraphrase":"Such risks could diminish the cash on hand that can be paid out to the Company’s stockholders.","different_hard":"These risks may increase the funds available for distribution to the Company’s stockholders."},
{"id":"ka0060","verbatim":"If a given lease, or guaranty of a lease, is not assumed, our cash flow and the amounts available for distributions to our stockholders may be negatively affected.","paraphrase":"Should a particular lease, or a guaranty of one, go unassumed, the cash we generate and the sums that can be distributed to our stockholders could be harmed.","different_hard":"If a given lease, or guaranty of a lease, is assumed, our cash flow and the amounts available for distributions to our stockholders may be adversely affected."},
{"id":"ka0061","verbatim":"One of the core promises of the Reform Act was to encourage competition among rating agencies.","paraphrase":"A principal aim of the Reform Act was to promote competition between rating agencies.","different_hard":"One of the central promises of the Reform Act was to discourage competition among rating agencies."},
{"id":"ka0062","verbatim":"the effects of terrorist activity and international hostilities, which could lead to business interruptions;","paraphrase":"the repercussions of acts of terror and international armed conflicts, which could cause business interruptions;","different_hard":"the effects of terrorist activity and international conflicts, which could lead to business growth;"},
{"id":"ka0063","verbatim":"difficulties associated with managing a large organization spread throughout several countries;","paraphrase":"challenges involved in running a big enterprise dispersed across numerous nations;","different_hard":"advantages associated with managing a large organization spread throughout various countries;"},
{"id":"ka0064","verbatim":"While we believe our wage rates are competitive and our relationships with our employees are satisfactory, a substantial increase in the wages paid by other employers could result in a reduction in our workforce, increases in wage rates, or both.","paraphrase":"Although we consider our pay scales competitive and our employee relations satisfactory, if other employers substantially raise what they pay, we may be forced to cut headcount, raise our own wages, or do both.","different_hard":"While we believe our wage rates are competitive and our relationships with our employees are satisfactory, a significant decrease in the wages paid by other employers could result in a reduction in our workforce, increases in wage rates, or both."},
{"id":"ka0065","verbatim":"In particular, we are frequently required to pay a higher commission rate to a gaming establishment than we previously paid in order to renew the relationship.","paraphrase":"Specifically, renewing a relationship with a casino often obliges us to accept a commission rate above the one we previously paid.","different_hard":"In particular, we are often required to pay a lower commission rate to a gaming establishment than we previously paid in order to renew the relationship."},
{"id":"ka0066","verbatim":"The construction of new homes may experience decline due to over supply of home inventory levels, lack of availability of credit, the unavailability and unaffordability of land in desirable metropolitan areas, shortages of skilled tradespeople, shortages of materials and regulations that impose restrictive zoning and density requirements.","paraphrase":"New home construction may decline because of excess supply of homes on the market, limited credit availability, the lack and high cost of land in desirable metropolitan areas, a shortage of skilled labor, a shortage of building materials, and regulations imposing restrictive zoning and density requirements.","different_hard":"The construction of new homes may experience growth due to over supply of home inventory levels, lack of availability of credit, the unavailability and unaffordability of land in attractive metropolitan areas, shortages of qualified tradespeople, shortages of materials and regulations that impose restrictive zoning and density requirements."},
{"id":"ka0067","verbatim":"Our greater exposure to potential losses could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.","paraphrase":"If we become more exposed to possible losses, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.","different_hard":"Our increased exposure to potential losses could have a material beneficial effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations."},
{"id":"ka0068","verbatim":"We have historically relied on revenues generated from customers originally contacted through our catalog mailings.","paraphrase":"Historically, we have depended on revenue from customers whose first contact with us came through catalog mailings.","different_hard":"We have historically relied on revenues generated from customers initially contacted through our internet advertising."},
{"id":"ka0069","verbatim":"As a result, the actual prices at which we are able to sell our assets may be lower than anticipated in connection with the adoption and approval of the Plan of Liquidation, which would result in the amount available for distributions to our stockholders being less than the amount anticipated in connection with the adoption and approval of the Plan of Liquidation.","paraphrase":"Consequently, the prices we actually obtain on sales of our properties could fall short of what was projected when the Plan of Liquidation was adopted and approved, so that distributions to our stockholders end up below the level expected at that time.","different_hard":"As a result, the actual prices at which we are able to sell our properties may be greater than anticipated in connection with the adoption and approval of the Plan of Liquidation, which would result in the amount available for distributions to our stockholders being greater than the amount anticipated in connection with the adoption and approval of the Plan of Liquidation."},
{"id":"ka0070","verbatim":"We are subject to risks associated with sales in several countries.","paraphrase":"We face risks linked to selling products in more than one country.","different_hard":"We are not subject to risks associated with sales in multiple countries."},
{"id":"ka0071","verbatim":"If disputes arise between our collaborators and us, our collaborators may act in their best interest and not in our best interest, which could adversely affect our business.","paraphrase":"Should disagreements emerge between us and our partners, the partners may pursue their own interests rather than ours, and that could harm our business.","different_hard":"If conflicts arise between our collaborators and us, our collaborators may act in our best interest and not in their best interest, which could benefit our business."},
{"id":"ka0072","verbatim":"take any action which would be forbidden under the provisions of any subordination agreement or make any payment on subordinated debt that any person was not entitled to receive under the provisions of the relevant subordination agreement.","paraphrase":"carry out any step barred by the terms of any subordination agreement, or pay subordinated debt to anyone not entitled to receive it under the applicable subordination agreement.","different_hard":"take any action which would be permitted under the provisions of any subordination agreement or make any payment on subordinated debt that any person was entitled to receive under the provisions of the applicable subordination agreement."},
{"id":"ka0073","verbatim":"A failure of any of our personnel to observe our policies and guidelines designed to reduce exposure to these risks could have a material effect upon us.","paraphrase":"If any of our staff fail to follow the policies and guidelines meant to limit our exposure to these risks, we could be materially affected.","different_hard":"A failure of any of our personnel to observe our policies and guidelines intended to reduce exposure to these risks could have no material effect upon us."},
{"id":"ka0074","verbatim":"However, such laws may permit a tenant or an appointed insolvency representative to terminate a lease if it so chooses.","paraphrase":"Even so, these laws could allow a tenant, or an insolvency representative appointed for it, to end a lease if it decides to do so.","different_hard":"Nonetheless, such laws may prohibit a tenant or an appointed insolvency representative from terminating a lease even if it so chooses."}
]
